Quick summary (high level):

- Week 2 (3/29): Legal reviews DPA redlines; Sales Ops prepares order form draft.
- Week 3 (4/02): MSA signature target (can be internal e-sign); DPA countersigned by legal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP + evidence ask for Crestline pilot — need legal + ops sequencing

Marissa / Laura / Maria —

We reviewed Marissa's MAP-Crestline-v1 and procurement notes. High-level legal sequencing and gating recommendations:

1) Triage DPA clauses by severity (3 buckets):
  - Category A (blocking): unrestricted subprocessing / unlimited liability / data residency override.
  - Category B (high touch): specific audit / deletion SLAs needing engineering signoff.
  - Category C (cosmetic): minor language edits.

2) Proposed turnaround and owner:
  - 3/26: Legal initial pass + mark Category A/B items (Karthik) — deliverable: annotated redlines.
  - 3/27–3/28: Sales Ops + Procurement negotiate Category B items (may need engineering input).
  - 4/01: Final legal sign-off on DPA; prepare MSA for signature.

3) Contingency plan: If Category A items appear, propose a limited-scope DPA addendum for the pilot (data residency to be scoped out), allow order form to proceed with conditional provisioning hold.

Attachment: DPA_redlines_karthik_20290322.docx (annotated).

I believe the April 5 order form target is achievable provided no Category A terms surface. If they do, we should communicate a 7–10 business day delay to Crestline and propose the addendum approach.

Karthik Iyer
Lead Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
